#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

struct Point {
    long long x1, x2, x3, x4, x5;
    Point(long long x1, long long x2, long long x3, long long x4, long long x5) : x1(x1), x2(x2), x3(x3), x4(x4), x5(x5) {}
    long long prod(const Point& other) const {
        return x1 * other.x1 + x2 * other.x2 + x3 * other.x3 + x4 * other.x4 + x5 * other.x5;
    }
    Point sub(const Point& other) const {
        return Point(x1 - other.x1, x2 - other.x2, x3 - other.x3, x4 - other.x4, x5 - other.x5);
    }
};

bool check(const vector<Point>& points, int i) {
    int n = points.size();
    for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
        if (j == i) continue;
        for (int k = 0; k < n; ++k) {
            if (k == i || k == j) continue;
            Point x = points[j].sub(points[i]);
            Point y = points[k].sub(points[i]);
            if (x.prod(y) > 0) return false;
        }
    }
    return true;
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    int n;
    cin >> n;
    if (n > 11) {
        cout << "0\n";
        return 0;
    }

    vector<Point> points;
    points.reserve(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        long long x1, x2, x3, x4, x5;
        cin >> x1 >> x2 >> x3 >> x4 >> x5;
        points.emplace_back(x1, x2, x3, x4, x5);
    }

    vector<int> ret;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        if (check(points, i)) ret.push_back(i + 1);
    }

    cout << ret.size() << "\n";
    for (int x : ret) {
        cout << x << "\n";
    }
    return 0;
}
